levels.label: Citadel Wards
levels.note: ME1 BIOA_STA60 sublevels. Geometry is in _LAY, _ART, and _PLC; blocking volumes are in the base _DSG. The single-letter _DSG variants (02a, 05A, ...) and 09casino hold the furnishings (market stalls, bar seating, clinic beds, casino tables); the named plot-state variants (01destiny, 03quarian, 11news, ...) are left out.
